title: Sailing at Night
subtitle: I've seen you when we were two boards, side by side, drifting on the sea.

trails.title: Divination Beginner
trails.description: You see blurry silhouettes in the crystal orb.

items.text: Sailing at Night
Guest Room, St. Foundation

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Silver divination stand, white silk, pearls soaked in night dew ...

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Hmm, what else lunar materials do I need ...

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Alright! Let me see how much frankincense and myrrh are left ...

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Cool, just the quantity I need.
Matilda immerses herself in the work on the desk. She checked the installment of the curtains repeatedly, making sure the moonlight will precisely shed on the orb.
A low noise is growing in a vessel not far away from her.
But she has no clue at all.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Okay, all set. Incense basin, my incense basin ...
She turns around.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Ahhh!
The incense basin falls, making a hollow sound on the Soumak.
A pair of pointy ears emerge from behind the basin.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: You again! Annoying divination sprites!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: You are not stealing anything from me this time!
Her attitude doesn't bother these transparent creatures at the moment.
Unlike any ordinary critters who always act in a group, only one or two of them are more than enough to get people in trouble.
Their thin, slim hands grab hold of the edge of the silver incense basin. They are flying towards the window.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Hey! Where are you taking my basin?! Stop it!
She jumps up the windowsill and grips the other edge of the basin.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Ugh ... Looks like you need a good lesson to understand why you shouldn't do this!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Wait and see. I'll let you know the consequence of messing with Ms. Matilda Bouanich!
The silver basin falls to the floor, knocking a shallow crater on it.
The sprites are crawling under the window, looking flabby and weak. Apparently, they have taken quite a shock.
Matilda picks up the basin and wipes out the dust.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Ha, he who laughs last, laughs best! It's me, ME!
They burst out an incomprehensible curse, sneaking away from the window with drooping wings on their backs.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Ugh ... these troublemakers. I'm exhausted.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: It's kinda late ... Oh! Thank goodness, I didn't miss the high tide!
Hurriedly, she starts to restore the order on the desk.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Set the props ...

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: I can't be distracted again. Divination takes my full attention and energy ...
However, there's a knock on the door.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Ahem! The high tide caused by the moon is coming. Let me see, estimated to start at 20:45.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Three minutes to go.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Gotta purify the orb when the high tide starts to make sure the divination is correct ...
The knock comes again.
Matilda frowns.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Calm down, calm down. This is the key moment ... Whoever it is, I must not be distracted!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Alright ... Focus, focus.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Eyes closed ... Focus ... Imagine my body rising and falling alongside the tide under the blessing of the moon ...

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: And she is on the other side of the sea ... waiting for me to find her ...

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Time to burn the incense ...

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Show yourself in the orb, Sonett- ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Matilda, are you there?

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Wh-what is ... going on?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I am sorry, but I think I heard your voice.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I need to ask you ... a favor.
Her voice sounds different. Exhausted, almost rusty, as if it were coming out from an old cassette.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: C-coming! Um, w-wait a minute!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: I'm, uh, busy! W-Wait there and be patient!
In a great panic, she pulls up the silk, covers the orb, and sticks the both of them into a corner of the couch.
The door opens.
They both stand inside the door frame, toe to toe, blocking each other's way. As they awkwardly try to move, they go up and retreat in the same direction, as if this were a tango tutorial.
Matilda eventually steps back and lets Sonetto in.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Now tell me your request! Wh-what brings you to the bright and intelligent Ms. Bouanich at this time?!
Sonetto forces a smile on her face.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Could you please read the future for me?
Matilda sees something she has never seen before on Sonetto's face.
They sit down by the orb.
Myrrh is quietly burning next to them.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Alright. Now is a good time to ask the moon for help ...

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Clean your hands in the silver pot, and put them on mine.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Okay. Now sit opposite me, and gaze into the orb.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Okay.
She does what she is told. She sees nothing but a clear whiteness in the orb.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Are you here to confess, to interpret a dream, or to seek the prophecy of the crystal?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I am here to confess ... and to seek the prophecy.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Tell me about the vision in your heart.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The vision ...?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Hmm ...
She looks at the orb. The shape of the sphere becomes blurry and gradually fades out in her sight.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: See myself falling ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: There are two broken decks ... They were originally one piece.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Every time I get closer to one deck, the other one sinks.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: People on it will fall with it.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I can feel the coldness of the deep water, and the pains when they struggle.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Are you sad about it?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I feel fear.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: I see ... Which deck would you like to approach intuitively? Can you recognize the people on them?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: There is something bright on that deck, just like ... Timekeeper and Druvis ... It is warm there.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: ... You are attracted to it subconsciously. It guides the way of your heart.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: What about the other?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The other deck ... makes me feel comfortable, as if I have spent a long time there.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I can trace back every step I take.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Perhaps that symbolizes your senses.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Sonetto, are you having trouble making a choice?

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: I can see the conflict ... between your instinct and senses.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: I heard you attended the committee's meeting today.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Anything happened?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I said something wrong.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I was not properly prepared ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I was unable to help Timekeeper and Druvis; instead, I created a deeper misunderstanding.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: What choice should I make ... to resolve their conflict? Stalemate like that ... really scares me.
Matilda can't find a word.
She sits there frozen, covering Sonetto's wrist with her palms.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: The bright deck ... seems closer and larger.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Have you ever thought about following your heart?

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Sonetto, maybe you can try following your instinct for once.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Maybe something unexpected will happen.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I tried.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... Four years ago.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I let them go ... That was the worst decision I have ever made.
Sonetto's hands are on the orb again.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I am ready. Please tell me the right choice.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: ... Okay.
As the chaotic snowflakes disappear, the shape of the orb is becoming blurry again.
Crystals emerge in thin air ...
... One after another, they build up a symmetrical and balanced ship.
Everything has its trace to follow, its logic to function.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: "The reality has shown itself."

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: "Take the path you have already taken, walk the way you have already walked."

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: "You shall benefit from listening to the voice in your mind, as it is not yet time to dock."

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Listen to the voice in my mind ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I see.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I should not have hesitated.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Thank you, Matilda. Your divination is very helpful ... My mind is very clear now.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: You're ... Ha, of course you should thank me!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: You should have known the resourcefulness of Ms. Matilda Bouanich much earlier.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: For your information, those seeking my help must make an appointment at least 15 days before the divination, otherwise, they won't even get to see me!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Haha.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: You were very serious during the divination ... Even your tone was different from usual.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: However, I am more familiar with the way you talk now ... It reminds me of our time at school.
Matilda stands there, transfixed.
Sonetto waves at her and walks out of the room.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Thank you for making time for me, Matilda.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: If you need my help next time, please let me know.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Good night.
The door is carefully closed behind her.
TO BE CONTINUED…
